# Swix Sport

> > Premium Nordic sports equipment and ski maintenance products from Norway's leading brand, featuring Triac poles, World Cup wax systems, and fluoro-free racing technology.

Founded by Börje Gabrielsson in 1940s Sweden, Swix has become the global standard for cross-country skiing equipment, ski wax, and tuning tools. The company sponsors Team Swix athletes including Jessie Diggins and provides World Cup racing technology while leading the industry transition to fluoro-free wax formulations.

## Key Topics

- Cross-country skiing
- Ski wax and waxing systems
- Triac pole technology
- World Cup racing equipment
- Edge tuning and ski maintenance
- Fluoro-free wax (PFAS removal)
- Base edge beveling
- Team Swix athletes
- Nordic sports apparel
- Glide wax application
- TCS pole system
- Ski preparation and structuring
- Racing equipment
- Winter sports gear
- Sustainable ski products

## Ski Waxing & Preparation Guides

- [Large guide: Fluor free ski wax](https://swixsport.com/eu/article/wax/fluorine-free-ski-waxing-swix): Complete guide to Swix fluoro-free wax: PS, HS, TS, and Marathon series
- [Structure tools: Comprehensive guide to manually structuring your skis](https://swixsport.com/eu/article/wax/filing-manual-structure-skis): Guide to manual ski structuring using T0424 rolling and T0401 filing tools
- [How to get skis and snowboards ready for winter](https://swixsport.com/us/article/cross-country-ski/ski-snowboard-base-preparation): Winter prep guide: removing klister, base cleaning, and edge tuning
- [How to use a wax machine](https://swixsport.com/us/swixschool/how-to-use-a-wax-machine): Tutorial: Using Swix glide wax and klister machine step-by-step
- [Guidelines and recommendations when waxing your skis](https://swixsport.com/us/sustainability/waxing-regulations): Safety guidelines for ski waxing: ventilation, masks, fluoro-free products

## Edge Tuning Tools & Equipment

- [TA520 Base file guide, 0,5 to 2,0°](https://swixsport.com/us/tools/edge-tuning/ta520-base-file-guide-0-5-to-2-0--TA520-V): TA520 adjustable file guide for 0.5° to 2.0° base edge angles
- [TA20N Base Edge Beveling tool 2,0°](https://swixsport.com/us/tools/edge-tuning/ta20n-base-edge-beveling-tool-2-0--TA20N-V): TA20N aluminum file guide for 2.0° base edge beveling on alpine skis
- [TA075N Base Edge Beveling tool0,75°](https://swixsport.com/us/tools/edge-tuning/ta075n-base-edge-beveling-tool0-75--TA075N-V): TA075N World Cup file guide for 0.75° base edge beveling precision
- [TA587 Side Edge File Guide, 87°](https://swixsport.com/us/tools/edge-tuning/ta587-side-edge-file-guide-87--TA587-V): TA587 aluminum file guide for 87° side edge tuning on alpine/snowboard
